# 📊 STRATEGIC SEO AUDIT REPORT — Dev9b (f9xr.org)

**Generated by:** F9XR Team — https://f9xr.org/
**Generated on:** 2026-10-09
**Audit Scope:** Local Repository Codebase (full site)
- Source: `content/` (34 posts in `content/post/`) — freshly built with Hugo v0.165.0 extended (`hugo --gc --minify --cleanDestinationDir`), theme Hugo Theme Stack v4.0.3, site root `https://f9xr.org/`.
- Rendered output: **168 pages, 119 HTML files** (posts use `/p/<slug>/` permalinks).
- Method: static analysis of front matter + built HTML (title/meta/canonical/H1/robots), automated crawl audit of `public/`, URL-manifest diffing (`llms.txt`, `articles-urls.txt`, deploy IndexNow list), link-graph review.

## Executive Summary

The site is technically healthy. **All High-severity findings from the 2026-09-20 audit are resolved and verified in the build:**

- **0 duplicate titles and 0 duplicate meta descriptions** across all 119 HTML files (previous: 404 page, `/categories/`, `/tags/`, and pagination sub-pages shared titles/descriptions; home `page/2+` reused page 1's description).
- **404 page fully optimized:** custom title "Page not found - F9XR's Dev9b", descriptive meta, canonical to `https://f9xr.org/`, `robots: noindex, follow`, matching og:description.
- **Crawl-manifest completeness:** `static/llms.txt` and `static/articles-urls.txt` now list **33/33 published article URLs**; `deploy.yml` IndexNow `urlList` now submits the **same 33 `/p/` URLs + homepage** (6 URLs were missing; a test page `feature-test` is intentionally excluded from all three).
- **Taxonomy cleanup:** `/categories/` and `/tags/` index pages have unique descriptions; orphaned `example-category` stub and the 1-post `categories/dev9b` (which collided with `tags/dev9b`) were removed. Pagination sub-pages now carry a unique " (Page N of M)" description suffix.
- **Footer is scrollable** (sticky reveal removed); no layout regression.

**Remaining findings: 1 Medium (tag bloat), 4 Low, several verified-good.** The 113 automated findings are all a single root cause: **2 `<h1>` tags per page** (the theme's sidebar site-name H1 + the page's real H1) on 112 pages, plus an intentional 3rd H1 on the markdown-syntax demo post. This is a deliberate theme design (Google permits multiple H1s); ranked Low.

**Single most important action:** consolidate/noindex the **56 tag pages (54 of which index a single post)** — it is the only remaining issue that dilutes crawl budget at scale.

## Quick Wins (Can be implemented in <30 mins)

- **Noindex deep pagination:** add `{{ if and .IsSection .Paginator.HasPrev }}noindex{{ end }}` headers for `/post/page/N`, `/tags/page/N`, `/categories/*/page/N`.
- **Author consistency on Cloudflare post:** set `author: F9XR Team` to match the Organization pattern, or supply `authorUrl`/`authorGitHub` + `sameAs`.
- **Related-posts links:** drop 2-3 in-content links between the OpenCode posts (`opencode-skills-guide` ↔ `opencode-vscode-setup` ↔ `opencode-mcp-servers` ↔ `how-to-setup-opencode-tui` ↔ `opencode-vs-cursor`).

## Medium-Term Improvements (1-4 weeks)

- **Tag consolidation:** cap 3-5 tags/post; for tags with ≤1 post emit `robots: noindex, follow` (keeps human navigation, drops crawl-diluting index entries). Re-run audit to confirm sitemap stays lean.
- **Thin-post expansion** with comparison tables (opencode-vs-cursor is designed as a comparison post yet has none), worked examples for the hugo-* posts, and a "How it works in practice" section for ai-coding-agents-explained.
- **IndexNow automation:** generate the deploy `urlList` from the built `sitemap.xml` at deploy time instead of a hand-edited constant.

## Long-Term Strategic Initiatives (1-3 months)

- **Topic hub architecture:** a pillar page linking the 7-post OpenCode cluster and the AI-agent cluster to consolidate entity signals and internal-link equity.
- **AI/LLM readiness evolution:** keep `llms.txt`/`articles-urls.txt` in sync automatically; add open browser-extension/SDK discovery opportunities for the AI-agent tutorials.

## Granular Pillar Evaluations

### On-Page SEO
- **Files Audited:** all `layouts/_partials/data/title.html`, `data/description.html`, `head/head.html`, `head/custom.html`, `head/opengraph/provider/base.html`, all post front matter.
- **Passed Checks:** 100% unique `<title>` (all ≤ 60 chars); 100% unique meta description (118-168 chars); absolute canonicals to `https://f9xr.org/p/<slug>/`; `index,follow` everywhere except 404 (`noindex, follow`); `og:type=article`, `twitter:card`, `article:published/modified_time`; keyword-bearing slugs.
- **Issues Found:**
  - **Issue 1: 2 H1s per page (112 pages)**
    - **Severity:** Low
    - **Location:** `layouts/partials/widget/site-brand.html` (theme) + each page template
    - **Problem:** The sidebar site name "F9XR's Dev9b" renders as `<h1>` on every page alongside the page's real H1; `markdown-syntax-guide-for-dev9b` adds a third (its demo headings render inside the content).
    - **Current Code:** `<h1 class="site-name">F9XR's Dev9b</h1>` (sidebar) + `<h1>` post/taxonomy title.
    - **Root Cause:** Theme default; Google treats multiple H1s as valid HTML5 structure.
    - **Ranking Impact:** ~0. Accepted as design.
    - **Fix (optional):** demote brand to `<p class="site-name">` on article/taxonomy layouts.
    - **Fix Type:** structural
    - **Verification:** re-run `audit_site.py` → expect 113 H1 pairs → 0.

### Technical SEO
- **Passed:** valid sitemap.xml + robots.txt on `/`; IndexNow key `3FFE8AD1224F6498C1B5162A3A4A4907.txt` served at `/`; 0 duplicate titles/descriptions; broken-link scan shows only external share/report widgets (false positives containing `f9xr.org` in query params).
- **Issues Found:** tag/taxonomy bloat and noindex deep pagination (see matrix #1, #5).

### Performance SEO (Core Web Vitals)
- **Passed:** fully static SSG (no runtime JS), cover images emitted with `loading=eager fetchpriority=high` + responsive `srcset`; built images 3-36 KB.
- **Issue (Low):** original cover files >300 KB in repo (`opencode-mcp-servers/cover.png` 609 KB, `opencode-skills-guide/cover.webp` 460 KB) inflate build/repo weight; lived-covered by processing.
- **Issue (Low):** Disqus third-party script on every article — recommend opt-in/lazy.

### E-E-A-T
- **Passed:** all posts emit TechArticle + Organization + BreadcrumbList JSON-LD; FAQPage on tutorials; editorial-policy and contribute pages present.
- **Issue (Medium):** Cloudflare post `author: dev9b` renders a Person without URL — inconsistent with the Organization brand used everywhere else.

### Rich Results
- **Passed:** FAQPage + TechArticle validated on tutorials; breadcrumbs present.
- **Note:** no Product/SoftwareApp schema on the tool-aggregation posts — not required for a descriptive blog.

### AI / AI Overviews
- **Passed:** `llms.txt` + `articles-urls.txt` fully cover 33 articles (fixed); robots.txt allows GPTBot/ClaudeBot/etc.; clean canonical/metadata now unambiguous for AI summarizers.

### CI/CD & Automation
- **Passed:** `deploy.yml` pings Google sitemap + IndexNow with **all 33 `/p/` URLs + homepage** (fixed this audit).
- **Issue (Low):** list is hand-maintained — automate from sitemap artifact.

### N/A pillars
E-Commerce (no store), Migration (no domain change), Competitor analysis (out of scope), Video SEO (no video content).

## Recommended Technical Implementation

3. **Deep-pagination noindex** for `/post/page/N`, `/tags/page/N`, `/categories/*/page/N`.
4. **Thin-post expansion** (opencode-vs-cursor comparison table first).
5. **Auto-generate** the IndexNow `urlList` from `sitemap.xml` in `deploy.yml`.
6. **Rebuild:** `hugo --gc --minify --cleanDestinationDir` → re-run `python audsec/audit_site.py` → confirm remaining findings are only H1-count pairs.
